ikonaro.name: check
ikonaro.kialo: The one sign every culture of the system reads as done or chosen: the selected entry of an elekto, the checked markobutono, the chosen item of a menuo.

ikonaro.name: chevron-down

meaning.de: Winkel nach unten: öffnet nach unten, aufklappbar

ikonaro.kialo: A list that opens below its control (elektilo, kompletigilo, the trigger of a menuo) and a faldilo that is closed announce it with the same sign; its direction is down in every writing direction, so it never mirrors.

ikonaro.name: chevron-left

meaning.de: Winkel gegen die Leserichtung: führt zurück

ikonaro.kialo: Leads back against the direction of reading — the previous page of a pagxigilo. The direction carries the meaning, so the glyph mirrors in right-to-left writing (Internacia).

ikonaro.name: chevron-right
ikonaro.kialo: Leads on in the direction of reading — a closed faldilo, a group of the navigado. The direction carries the meaning, so the glyph mirrors in right-to-left writing (Internacia).

ikonaro.name: close
ikonaro.kialo: Every layer that opens needs a sign that closes it (dialogo, sxvebilo), every avizo that can be dismissed and every kampo or kompletigilo that can be cleared uses the same one.

ikonaro.name: collapse
ikonaro.kialo: The counterpart of expand: a faldilo or a surface that takes its room back. The spec names the pair (G3); one sign for both directions would need a label to tell them apart.

ikonaro.name: danger
ikonaro.kialo: The status danger of an avizo and the invalid kampo need a sign beside the colour: colour alone is no information (WCAG 1.4.1). An octagon reads as stop and is told apart from warning (triangle) and close (cross) at small sizes.

ikonaro.name: expand
ikonaro.kialo: A faldilo or a surface that takes more room; the counterpart of collapse (G3).

ikonaro.name: external
ikonaro.kialo: The ligilo marks an external destination visibly and audibly (Regulo external-link-marked); the sign is the visible half. It does not mirror: the box with the arrow is read as a symbol, not as a direction.

ikonaro.name: info
ikonaro.kialo: The status info of an avizo needs a sign beside the colour (WCAG 1.4.1); the i in a circle is read across cultures.

ikonaro.name: more
ikonaro.kialo: The row actions of a tabelo and every place that hides further actions behind a menuo use the same three dots (G3 names it).

ikonaro.name: search
ikonaro.kialo: A kampo for searching and the kompletigilo announce what they do with the magnifier (G3 names it); the sign stands beside the field until a prefix inside the field exists (kampo icon-in-field, not supported).

ikonaro.name: sort-ascending
ikonaro.kialo: The sort part of a tabelo column shows its direction; an arrow alone would not say which way the data runs. Does not mirror: the order is read top-down in every writing direction.

ikonaro.name: sort-descending
ikonaro.kialo: The counterpart of sort-ascending on the sort part of a tabelo column.

ikonaro.name: success
ikonaro.kialo: The status success of an avizo and the valid kampo need a sign beside the colour (WCAG 1.4.1); the check in a circle is told apart from the bare check that means chosen.

ikonaro.name: warning
ikonaro.kialo: The status warning of an avizo needs a sign beside the colour (WCAG 1.4.1); the triangle is told apart from danger (octagon) and info (circle).
